evidence_quotes:
REASON FOR QUESTION
If the air filter is clogged, the engine will not develop full power. Engine may exhaust black smoke or it may not start at all.
statements.reason: The intake-air/exhaust checks identify failure to develop full power as a consequence of a clogged air filter.
statements.statement: Failure to develop full engine power is a stated reason to check the air-intake/exhaust system.

evidence_quotes:
PROCEDURES: Visually inspect dust unloader for
presence and for cuts, tears,
obstructions, worn areas, enlarged
gap, or if center opening exceeds
1/8 in. (3.175 mm).
statements.reason: The stated limit is 1/8 inch; 0.20 inch is larger, and converts to 5.08 mm.
statements.statement: A dust-unloader center opening of 0.20 inch (5.08 mm) exceeds the preventive maintenance check standard of 1/8 inch (3.175 mm).

evidence_quotes:
NOT FULLY MISSION CAPABLE IF: Dust unloader missing or
has cuts, tears, obstruc-
tions, worn areas,
enlarged gap, or if center
opening exceeds 1/8 in.
(3.175 mm).
statements.reason: The opening exceeds 1/8 inch, which the table lists as a not-fully-mission-capable condition.
statements.statement: With a dust-unloader center opening of 0.20 inch (5.08 mm), the unit is not fully mission capable.
